name: Iron County

actions.title: Meta Data Center Siting Approval (Cedar City area)
actions.summary: Iron County and Cedar City area approved land and utility arrangements for a large Meta data center campus, part of Meta's broader Utah expansion leveraging cheap land and power in the region.

contextBlurb: Iron County in southwestern Utah has attracted data center interest due to its available land, relatively cool climate at elevation, and access to power infrastructure. Cedar City, the county seat, has been a focal point for large-scale tech facility siting discussions.

name: Utah County

actions.title: (Lehi) Data Center Zoning and Tax Incentive Reviews
actions.summary: Lehi City, known as 'Silicon Slopes,' continued approving data center developments and associated tax incentive packages, with the Utah County area hosting multiple hyperscale facilities from companies including Adobe and Oracle.

contextBlurb: Utah County, home to the 'Silicon Slopes' tech corridor centered on Lehi, has become one of Utah's primary data center hubs. The area has grappled with balancing aggressive economic development incentives against water and grid infrastructure constraints.

name: Salt Lake County

actions.title: Utah Legislature / PUC Data Center Energy Rate Scrutiny
actions.summary: Salt Lake County stakeholders and the Utah Public Service Commission began scrutinizing preferential energy rate structures for large data centers, following concerns that hyperscale facilities were shifting grid upgrade costs onto residential ratepayers.

actions.title: (Salt Lake City) AI and Smart City Policy Framework Discussion
actions.summary: Salt Lake City began internal discussions on an AI governance and smart-city policy framework to guide municipal use of AI tools, including procurement standards and transparency requirements.

contextBlurb: Salt Lake County anchors Utah's data center boom and is home to major facilities operated by national hyperscalers. Rising concerns about water use from the Great Salt Lake watershed and electricity rate impacts on residents have prompted regulatory attention at both county and state levels.
